ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the difference between ف (faa) and ق (qaaf)? (1 mark)
   A. faa has two dots above and qaaf has one
   B. faa has one dot above and qaaf has two dots above
   C. faa has a dot below
   D. They have no dots

2. How many forms can an Arabic letter have at most? (1 mark)
   A. Four: alone, start, middle and end
   B. Two
   C. One
   D. Six

3. Which Arabic word means "mother's brother"? (1 mark)
   A. ابْنٌ
   B. أَخٌ
   C. أُخْتٌ
   D. خَالٌ

4. What is a good way to give feedback on someone's handwriting? (1 mark)
   A. Tear the page
   B. Say something good first, then give one tip
   C. Say nothing
   D. Laugh at it

5. Where should you write the Arabic name of a drawing? (1 mark)
   A. Under the drawing, from right to left
   B. Inside the drawing
   C. Only on the back
   D. In the margin from left to right

6. Which Arabic word means "clock"? (1 mark)
   A. كُرْسِيٌّ
   B. غُرْفَةٌ
   C. مِصْبَاحٌ
   D. سَاعَةٌ

7. Which of these is a masculine noun? (1 mark)
   A. naafidha (window)
   B. kursii (chair)
   C. taawila (table)
   D. qitta (cat)

8. Which is the correct spelling of Thursday? (1 mark)
   A. الخمبس
   B. الجميس
   C. الخميس
   D. الحميس

9. Which Arabic word means "Thursday"? (1 mark)
   A. الْجُمُعَةُ
   B. مَدْرَسَةٌ
   C. الْأَرْبِعَاءُ
   D. الْخَمِيسُ

10. What does the Arabic sentence أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. We dance.
   B. I have a gift.
   C. I like the party.
   D. My mother cooks the food.

11. What does the Arabic sentence نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a gift.
   B. We dance.
   C. I like the party.
   D. My mother cooks the food.

12. Which sentence means 'I drink milk'? (1 mark)
   A. as-samaku ladhiidh
   B. aakulu l-aruzza
   C. uhibbu l-khubza
   D. ashrabu l-haliiba

13. What does the Arabic sentence آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink tea.
   B. I eat rice.
   C. The banana is delicious.
   D. This is my hand.

14. Which Arabic sentence means "I eat rice." (1 mark)
   A. رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ
   B. آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ
   C. أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ
   D. الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ

15. What does the Arabic sentence رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I clean my teeth.
   B. My head is big.
   C. I wash my face.
   D. My hand is small.

16. Which Arabic word means "neck"? (1 mark)
   A. بَطْنٌ
   B. سِنٌّ
   C. جِسْمٌ
   D. رَقَبَةٌ

17. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا مَطَرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is the sun.
   B. This is rain.
   C. The sun is hot.
   D. The wind is strong.

18. Which Arabic word means "clean"? (1 mark)
   A. نَظِيفٌ
   B. زَهْرَةٌ
   C. شَجَرَةٌ
   D. غَائِمٌ

19. Which Arabic word means "on"? (1 mark)
   A. عَلَى
   B. عِنْدَ
   C. تَحْتَ
   D. بِجَانِبِ

20. What is a paragraph? (1 mark)
   A. One long word
   B. A drawing
   C. A single letter
   D. A group of sentences about one idea

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Rearrange the words to make a sentence and translate it: الْخَمِيسِ / يَوْمُ / الْيَوْمُ. (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into English: fii l-ghurfati sariir (2 marks)

23. List the six Arabic letters that do not join to the letter that follows them. (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Give three tips for neat handwriting with good word spacing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Translate into English: aakulu l-aruzza (2 marks)

26. Describe how to copy a family word neatly. (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Give three qualities of neat and legible writing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Explain why neat and legible writing matters when a poem is displayed. (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Translate into English: uhibbu baytii (2 marks)

30. Translate into English: ar-riihu qawiyya (2 marks)

31. Write one Arabic sentence about today's weather in sounds and translate it. (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Explain why correct spelling is important in Arabic. (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — faa has one dot above and qaaf has two dots above
   Only the dots separate these two letters.

2. A — Four: alone, start, middle and end
   A joining letter can look different alone, at the start, in the middle and at the end of a word.

3. D — خَالٌ
   خَالٌ (khaal) means mother's brother.

4. B — Say something good first, then give one tip
   Kind and helpful feedback encourages a friend to improve.

5. A — Under the drawing, from right to left
   Labels are written neatly from right to left.

6. D — سَاعَةٌ
   سَاعَةٌ (saaʿa) means clock.

7. B — kursii (chair)
   kursii is masculine. The other words end in -a and are feminine.

8. C — الخميس
   Thursday begins with khaa (خ), which has one dot above.

9. D — الْخَمِيسُ
   الْخَمِيسُ (al-khamiis) means Thursday.

10. D — My mother cooks the food.
   أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ (ummii tatbukhu T-taʿaam) means: My mother cooks the food.

11. B — We dance.
   نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ (nahnu narqusu) means: We dance.

12. D — ashrabu l-haliiba
   ashrabu means I drink and haliib means milk.

13. B — I eat rice.
   آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ (aakulu l-aruzza) means: I eat rice.

14. B — آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ
   آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ (aakulu l-aruzza) means: I eat rice.

15. B — My head is big.
   رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ (raʾsii kabiir) means: My head is big.

16. D — رَقَبَةٌ
   رَقَبَةٌ (raqaba) means neck.

17. B — This is rain.
   هَذَا مَطَرٌ (haadhaa matar) means: This is rain.

18. A — نَظِيفٌ
   نَظِيفٌ (nadhiif) means clean.

19. A — عَلَى
   عَلَى (ʿalaa) means on.

20. D — A group of sentences about one idea
   A paragraph is a group of related sentences about one idea.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ. Today is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first word, 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the translation.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the room there is a bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: alif, daal, dhaal, raa, zaay and waaw.
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all six; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Leave a gap about one letter wide between words; keep letters in a word joined smoothly; write on the baseline; put dots neatly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid tip.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: I eat rice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say the word aloud; look at each letter and mark; write it once and compare with the model; correct and write it again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Letters of the correct shape and same size; letters on the baseline; correct dots and marks; small spaces between words.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid quality.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Readers can read it easily, the dots and marks show the right words, and neat work shows care and pride.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like my house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: The wind is strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example al-jawwu baarid. The weather is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for the translation.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: A missing letter or a wrong dot can change the word, so the reader may not understand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a change in the word and 1 mark for understanding.
